entities.name: Yoshimaru
entities.description: A loyal dog and companion of the Emperor of Kamigawa.

entities.name: Emperor of Kamigawa
entities.description: The current emperor of Kamigawa, a planeswalker, mentored by Light-Paws.

entities.name: Light-Paws
entities.description: The Emperor's mentor who gave her a puppy.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where Yoshimaru was left with Aminatou.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: Event that freed the emperor of uncontrollable planeswalking.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: Town where Echoverse Yoshimaru led street dogs.

entities.name: Echoverse Yoshimaru
entities.description: Echoverse version of Yoshimaru, the feared leader of a pack of street dogs in Towashi.

events.summary: On her first day of training the Emperor's mentor Light-Paws gives her a puppy to raise; it becomes Yoshimaru.
events.quote: her mentor Light-Paws gave her a puppy, telling her to raise it by hand

events.summary: When the emperor disappears, Yoshimaru searches and guards her throne for years.
events.quote: For years, he guarded her throne, awaiting her return

events.summary: After the Desparkening the emperor returns home to Kamigawa and reunites with Yoshimaru.
events.quote: returned home to Kamigawa, reuniting with Yoshimaru

events.summary: Yoshimaru is left in Aminatou's care on Ravnica while his master braves Duskmourn, then returns to Kamigawa with her.
events.quote: left in the care of Aminatou while his master braved the plane of Duskmourn
